proof_body:
by
  intro u hu
  let F : Polynomial (PadicInt 2) := Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C u
  have hF : ∀ z, Polynomial.eval z F = z ^ 2 - u := by intro z; simp [F]
  have hF' : Polynomial.eval (1 : PadicInt 2) (Polynomial.derivative F) = 2 := by
    simp [F]; exact one_add_one_eq_two
  have h2 : ‖(2 : PadicInt 2)‖ = 1 / 2 := by
    have := PadicInt.norm_p (p := 2)
    simpa using this
  have hl : ‖Polynomial.aeval (1 : PadicInt 2) F‖ < ‖Polynomial.aeval (1 : PadicInt 2) (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', h2]
    have : ‖(1 : PadicInt 2) ^ 2 - u‖ = ‖u - 1‖ := by rw [one_pow, norm_sub_rev]
    rw [this]; linarith
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _, _, _⟩ := hensels_lemma hl
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF] at hz
  exact ⟨z, sub_eq_zero.1 hz⟩
